plan.title: [framework-gap] swarm:readiness flags 'placeholder' inside file names and domain terms as placeholder text

narratives.Description: Issue #6929 was folded into the #6936 story and fixed in product PR #7000 (merge 9061e61b). This brief records that delivery and adds no code. The tests that assert the fixed behaviour are in packages/core/src/vbrief-validation/marker-text.test.ts.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary
`swarm:readiness` story-quality checks flag the substring "placeholder" as placeholder text, even when it is part of a real file or component name.

## Context
A launcher story listed `web/src/components/desk/section-placeholder-widget.tsx` in its ImplementationPlan and described "placeholder widgets" (a real UI concept: stub widgets shown until content ships).

## Expected behavior
`PLACEHOLDER_ACCEPTANCE_PATTERNS` matches placeholder *text* (e.g. a criterion that is literally "placeholder" / "TBD"), not a domain word inside a path or a concrete sentence.

## Actual behavior / gap
Readiness reported `plan.narratives.ImplementationPlan must not be placeholder text` and `placeholder acceptance criterion`. Workaround: rename the file to `section-stub-widget.tsx` and reword the criteria. Same class: a top-bar criterion mentioning a "repo chip placeholder" was rejected.

## Session notes
Consider matching whole-criterion placeholders or skipping tokens inside path-like strings.


## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Given the three examples above (the desk widget file name, the widget term and the top-bar chip term, each holding the stub-marker word inside a longer term), when readiness checks acceptance criteria and the ImplementationPlan, then it reports no stub-text issue.
- [ ] Given a line that holds only a stub marker, a leading marker label with a colon, or a marker template token in angle brackets, when readiness checks it, then it still reports a stub-text issue.
- [ ] Given the same acceptance texts, when `scope:decompose` checks a story, then it applies the same stub-text check as readiness.

---
_Filed from a consumer session (deftai/evolution, runtime @deftai/directive-runtime 0.129.13, launcher @deftai/directive 0.129.14). Refs #1709_
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer whose file names and domain terms contain stub-marker words, I want readiness to read them as real text, so that my stories pass readiness without renaming files.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. No new code: PR #7000 shipped the fix under the #6936 story (deft-story: 6936).
2. Bind clauses 1-3 to packages/core/src/vbrief-validation/marker-text.test.ts, which #7000 added.
3. Complete in a lifecycle PR with --merge-commit 9061e61b7c196d9c0d3c983c4a151c5892c0a618 --pr 7000.

issueCommentThread.body: Folded into the #6936 story and fixed in #7000: readiness and `scope:decompose` now share one placeholder check. Multi-word stub phrases still match anywhere; `placeholder`, `todo` and `tbd` count only as a marker-only line, a leading label (`TODO:`, `**TODO:**`, `TBD -`), a template token (`<placeholder>`) or a standalone `tbd`, never inside a path-like token. So `section-placeholder-widget.tsx`, "placeholder widgets" and "repo chip placeholder" no longer read as placeholder text. Arc record: #6936 (synthesis 7073885133).
design-critique: not warranted, because the fix already shipped in #7000 under #6936; this brief only records delivery.
